fact: The World Bank mission of 27 May to 10 June 2025 records the contract for EMIS infrastructure expected to be signed by 4 July 2025 and the consultancy to develop an enhanced EMIS not yet contracted, pending extension of the project closing date.
title: Zambia Education Enhancement Project (ZEEP, 158570) Implementation Support Mission, May 27 to June 10, 2025 Aide Memoire
